description:
Desde 2003, a Facell nasceu com a ousadia de seus fundadores e se tornou um nome de peso como parceira estratégica da Tim. Nestes mais de 20 anos de história , construímos uma trajetória de reconhecimento nacional pela qualidade impecável dos nossos serviços e pela performance excepcional dos nossos profissionais. Aqui, cada desafio é um trampolim para o seu crescimento – uma chance real de transformar ambições em conquistas, tanto no âmbito profissional quanto pessoal. Se você se identifica com a nossa visão, prepare-se para uma jornada de realizações que ecoará por muitos anos!

Nossa Presença Forte no Nordeste

Com uma rede de 24 lojas físicas e um dinâmico Canal Digital , o Grupo Facell conecta pessoas em 3 estados vibrantes do Nordeste: Ceará, Bahia e Rio Grande do Norte. Nossa equipe, com mais de 300 talentos , é o coração do nosso sucesso.

Nossa sede administrativa, pulsando em Natal , é o centro de suporte estratégico, onde profissionais especializados em desenvolvimento, logística, finanças e gestão trabalham em sinergia para impulsionar o sucesso de cada colaborador. Nosso compromisso é claro: equipar você para alcançar resultados extraordinários.

Nosso Legado, Seu Propósito

  • Missão: Há mais de duas décadas, promovemos experiências transformadoras em tecnologia e conectividade para nossos clientes.
  • Visão: Consolidamos nossa posição como número 1 em qualidade e produtividade na Tim Nordeste, e continuamos a mirar o futuro com a mesma ambição.
  • Valores: Nosso alicerce é o compromisso inabalável com a excelência no atendimento, o foco em resultados que impulsionam o crescimento, o investimento contínuo no desenvolvimento humano, a humildade que nos mantém conectados e a energia contagiante que nos move.
  • Negócio: Em mais de 20 anos, construímos a reputação de oferecer sempre a melhor escolha, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para nossa equipe.

Seu Próximo Capítulo Começa Aqui!

O Grupo Facell te convida a fazer parte de uma história de sucesso com mais de duas décadas de impacto. Se você busca mais do que um emprego – busca um lugar onde sua paixão e talento serão valorizados, onde os desafios se convertem em oportunidades e onde sua jornada profissional terá um legado duradouro – nossas portas estão abertas para você!

  • Conduzir reuniões de equipe e individuais para alinhar objetivos, discutir resultados, compartilhar melhores práticas e mediar conflitos entre os funcionários (e, quando necessário, com clientes).
  • Colaborar no levantamento das necessidades de treinamento e desenvolvimento (TD) técnico e comportamental da equipe.

title: Banco de Talentos para Técnicos e Engenheiros de Campo - Salvador
description:
Conheça a nossa história!

Na Imex acreditamos que a inovação é a chave para um futuro mais saudável. Somos uma empresa inovadora, com uma forte presença no mercado de saúde e tecnologia. Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos especialistas nesse segmento e a nossa missão é transformar o setor de saúde por meio de equipamentos médicos de alta qualidade, tanto para uso humano quanto veterinário, atuando em todo o Brasil.

Aqui valorizamos o compromisso com resultados e a colaboração entre as pessoas. Valorizamos o comprometimento, a diversidade e a autenticidade de cada um, e acreditamos que quando todos crescem juntos, o impacto é ainda maior.

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Especialista Técnico em Equipamentos de Diagnóstico por Imagem , você será responsável por garantir a instalação, manutenção e suporte técnico dos nossos equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem, garantindo a qualidade e a confiabilidade de nossos produtos no campo. Seu trabalho será essencial para o bom funcionamento dos equipamentos nos hospitais e clínicas, sempre buscando a excelência no atendimento aos nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Realizar instalação, calibração e manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem (radiologia, ultrassonografia, tomografia, entre outros).
  • Oferecer suporte técnico remoto e presencial aos clientes, solucionando dúvidas e problemas técnicos.
  • Treinar usuários sobre a operação e manutenção dos equipamentos.
  • Diagnosticar falhas e realizar reparos de acordo com os procedimentos da empresa.
  • Acompanhar e controlar os indicadores de performance dos equipamentos, gerando relatórios técnicos para os gestores.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de vendas, engenharia e atendimento ao cliente para garantir a satisfação dos clientes.
  • Assegurar que todos os procedimentos de segurança e regulamentações técnicas sejam seguidos rigorosamente.
Requisitos e qualificações

Para fazer a sua história acontecer aqui, precisamos que você domine esses assuntos:

  • Formação técnica ou superior em áreas como Engenharia Biomédica, Engenharia Eletrônica, Física Médica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia com equipamentos de diagnóstico por imagem (radiologia, ultrassonografia, tomografia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em processos de manutenção e calibração de equipamentos médicos;
  • Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos com agilidade e precisão;
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar;
  • CNH de categoria B;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e deslocamentos conforme demanda.
Agora, se você quiser se diferenciar, é bom você ter…
  • Conhecimento em normas regulatórias da ANVISA e demais regulamentações do setor de saúde;
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e normas internacionais;
  • Experiência prévia em empresas do segmento de equipamentos médicos ou saúde.
Informações adicionais

O que você ganha ao fazer parte da nossa história

  • Trabalhar em um ambiente inovador e com grande potencial de crescimento profissional;
  • Possibilidade de atuação remota ou em diversos pontos do Brasil, com flexibilidade de horários;
  • Participação em programas de capacitação e treinamentos contínuos;
  • Excelente oportunidade de desenvolvimento de carreira no setor de saúde e tecnologia.
Região de atuação?

Salvador, Bahia.

Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e saúde, deseja fazer a diferença em um setor inovador e em crescimento, cadastre-se e venha fazer parte da nossa história!

title: Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization.

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices
YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES
  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability
COMPETENCIES
  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

title: Gerente de projetos de TI
description:
Quem somos:

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção global digital, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, o Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo, tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


O que buscamos:

Como Gerente de Projetos, você trabalhará em colaboração com a equipe do Studio Rx e os times de Projetos e Client Services nos EUA. Diariamente, você deverá monitorar as atividades dos projetos em andamento, identificando e mitigando riscos, além de manter uma comunicação fluída entre todas as equipes envolvidas.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento do plano do projeto: desde o entendimento e definição do escopo/briefing, passando pela estimativa de esforço e elaboração de cronogramas;
  • Alocação de equipe de acordo com habilidades necessárias, experiência e disponibilidade em parceria com o líder técnico da área de execução do projeto;
  • Gerenciamento e monitoramento das atividades diárias do projeto, garantindo o recebimento de todas as informações e materiais para execução das atividades, seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos, consolidando as informações em relatórios para a liderança sênior do projeto;
  • Garantir a comunicação entre os times de execução e demais envolvidos no projeto;
  • Esclarecimento de dúvidas quanto ao direcionamento da execução das atividades, interagindo com equipes responsáveis pelo projeto nos EUA;
  • Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com prazos e tempo estimado, com a qualidade exigida, e seguindo os protocolos de trabalho do Studio no Brasil e EUA;
  • Elaboração de relatórios de andamento do projeto, e demais relatórios necessários para acompanhamento dos principais indicadores de sucesso das áreas de atuação.


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente (escrito e falado), pois trabalhará diretamente com times globais;
  • Graduação em áreas relacionadas à comunicação (Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Comunicação Social) ou TI (Processamento de dados, Análise de sistemas, Ciências da Computação);
  • Experiência consolidada com gestão de projetos.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em agências de comunicação/publicidade;
  • Experiência no segmento healthcare (certificação Veeva é um plus);
  • Proficiência em metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos (Agile, Scrum etc.);
  • Proficiência em sistemas e/ou softwares de gerenciamento de projetos (MSFT Project, Workfront, Jira etc.)
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas usadas por desenvolvedores front-end e de campanhas digitais (Google Web Designer, Doubleclick Studio, GitHub, Adobe Creative Suite etc.).



Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: Consultor(a) SAP SD Sênior
description:
Consultor(a) SAP SD Sênior

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Visão Geral da Posição

Estamos em busca de um profissional sênior com forte atuação consultiva e experiência em projetos de implementação e rollout SAP SD, capaz de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções eficientes, mantendo sinergia com times multifuncionais e práticas globais.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos e desenho de soluções funcionais;
  • Realizar parametrização, testes e suporte pós-go-live;
  • Garantir alinhamento entre áreas de negócio e TI, atuando de forma colaborativa;
  • Apoiar projetos S/4HANA, integrações e melhorias contínuas


Qualificações:

  • SAP SD completo (vendas, faturamento, pricing, shipping, impostos);
  • Experiência em projetos end-to-end e metodologias ágeis;
  • Desejável vivência com S/4HANA.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de debbug, já que é um sênior precisamos deste perfil para aprofundar em analise. Porque no projeto tenho time de abap.


Requisitos :

  • +5 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP SD;
  • Participação em implementações completas;
  • Perfil colaborativo, ágil e orientado a resultados;
  • Inglês avançado
  • Espanhol (Diferencial)


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Software Engineer with 8 to 12 years of software programming experience, including a strong background in Golang, Kubernetes, major cloud platforms, and CI/CD. You will fully automate provisioning, deployment, management, and monitoring for a rapidly evolving and highly scalable set of SaaS services. You will work with members of the DevOps team alongside a DevOps architect to ensure best practices are implemented across applications, lead teams in the direction of initiatives, such as CI/CD and enterprise monitoring, and work on support services operational on the cloud.

You are the ideal candidate if you enjoy improving engineering efficiency, mentoring junior team members, promoting best practices, and solving problems by digging into the technical details.

Our client was named a Top 25 Cybersecurity Company by The Software Report and one of Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work in 2020. The company is a leader in cloud-based networking and security services. Their services empower organizations to optimize cloud usage, delivering network experiences that are simple, scalable, and reliable. The client counts 70% of the Fortune 500 companies as customers.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, design, and maintain features that empower developer productivity
  • Design and implement components of the client's next-generation, internal developer platform
  • Recommend ways to improve system reliability, efficiency, and quality
  • Work closely with various cross-functional product teams
  • Stay up-to-date on key trends, especially in the area of technologies and frameworks like Kubernetes, Docker, ELK/Prometheus, and more
  • Own platform engineering
  • Develop REST APIs and contribute to the overall API framework
  • Use multiple open software to build a developer platform


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8 to 12 years of experience in software development using programming languages
  • Experience with Golang, including building API and web services
  • Experience with DevOps technologies and methodologies, including Kubernetes, major cloud platforms (preferably AWS), and CI/CD
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture and container-based software, such as Docker
  • Experience developing microservices and using Cloud Services API
  • Strong focus on reliability and security
  • Solid exposure to application performance tuning, memory management, and scalability
  • Ability to design highly scalable distributed systems using different open-source technologies


Desired Experience

  • University degree or equivalent educational experience (preferably in a STEM field)
  • Additional container technologies besides Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services, such as EC2, VPC, ELB, S3, and CloudFormation, or equivalent services in GCP and/or Azure


Additional Info

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter – think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let’s learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual – no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: React Native Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for React Native Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Build and Maintain features for our React Native-based iOS Apps.

- Deliver high quality, scalable and heavily tested software.

- Work on a cross-functional team, partnering across engineering, product, design, and business functions.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Front End development with strong skills in Javascript, CSS3 and HTML5.

- 1+ years of experience developing Web applications using ReactJS, Flux, Redux, Relay, etc.

- 2+ years of experience working with RoR.

- Familiar with the concepts of basic programming, data structures, types of variables and idiosyncrasies.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Vaga para SUPERVISOR DE VENDAS VAREJO em SALVADOR/BA.


Missão: Garantir que as políticas, processos e procedimentos de vendas estejam sendo executados com qualidade e no tempo certo. Fornecer as informações diárias e feedback constante aos seus liderados para atingir os objetivos da área comercial.


Que perfil buscamos?

Ensino superior completo em Administração, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins.

Experiência anterior na função.

Ter CNH B válida.

Necessário vivência com:

• Gestão de pessoas;

• Técnicas de vendas e atendimento a clientes;

• Técnicas de negociação;

• Gestão de indicadores de performance (coberturas, efetividade, devolução).

Manejo de ferramentas digitais e conhecimento do pacote office intermediário.


Quais serão seus desafios?

Supervisionar equipe de vendas, garantindo material necessário para a execução e repasse de informações através de reuniões (matinais e outras), acompanhando performance e o progresso de metas, de forma a garantir o alcance dos objetivos da área.

Acompanhar os pedidos dos clientes, identificando suas necessidades, realizando negociações de preços e prazos de entrega, para definir a melhor forma de atendimento e cumprimento das metas da área.

Elaborar e executar o Plano Semanal de Realização, para o cumprimento dos objetivos da área comercial.

Preparar relatórios e mapas demonstrativos sobre o desempenho da área para apresentação e apreciação ao gestor direto.

Identificar e negociar com novos clientes para agregar ao portfólio da empresa, bem como garantir o controle e integração dos novos cadastros.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Instructional Designer

Remote – Brazil | Contract | Full-Time


About the Role

Our client is looking for an Instructional Designer responsible for designing, developing, and delivering high-quality learning materials to support internal teams and partners. The focus will be on creating scalable, engaging learning experiences for product readiness, systems/process training, and ongoing enablement programs.

This role requires a self-sufficient professional with strong creative design capabilities and advanced proficiency in Articulate Storyline. The ideal candidate can quickly adapt, work independently, and collaborate effectively with subject matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop e-learning modules, videos, and other instructional content using Articulate Storyline and multimedia tools.
  • Manage multiple training projects, including systems/process training and product or solution readiness.
  • Collaborate with SMEs and internal teams to ensure content accuracy and alignment with business objectives.
  • Apply instructional design methodologies to ensure engaging and measurable learning outcomes.
  • Define content strategy and deliver final assets for publishing.
  • Track learner engagement and performance, using analytics and feedback to improve materials.
  • Stay up to date with instructional design trends and emerging technologies.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in instructional design or enablement, preferably in complex or technical environments.
  • Advanced proficiency in Articulate Storyline (must be able to start with minimal onboarding).
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong creative and visual design abilities to translate complex topics into clear, learner-centered content.
  • Experience developing learning materials for internal teams, sales enablement, or process training initiatives.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and features such as branching, gamification, and assessments.
  • Certification in Instructional Design or Sales Enablement .

title: Senior Counsel
description:
Our Senior Counsel will be responsible for leading client correspondence and managing client relationships. We value organized, collegial and highly motivated individuals with a client-centered approach to legal representation. This position is ideal for an entrepreneurial attorney who possesses strong leadership and communication skills and who thrives in a dynamic environment. The Senior Counsel will help shape our legal services, counseling our clients with clear and concise contract drafting, communicating with clients’ internal and external stakeholders, leading complex commercial negotiations, and providing counsel on general risk management. This role is for someone who is committed to offering best-in-class legal services and has a desire to be a proactive strategic partner.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the negotiation of SaaS agreements for clients negotiating with Fortune 500 customers, and identify, coordinate and resolve issues for subject matter expert review
  • Support clients’ business units with structuring and negotiating a variety of transactions relating to product commercialization and corporate development, including early-stage investments, joint ventures, and mergers and acquisitions
  • Provide general counsel and partner with third party subject matter experts to efficiently lead a comprehensive legal strategy
  • Assist with corporate governance processes including managing internal corporate actions, charters, bylaws, and board meeting materials
  • Collaborate with the Managing Counsel on business development activities to drive firm growth
  • Operate with limited supervision, demonstrate sound judgment and an ability to independently and effectively manage priorities, and proactively identify when to escalate issues with internal and client stakeholders


Qualifications

  • JD from a top tier law school and excellent academic credentials
  • Admission to the state bar where the candidate resides
  • 6+ years of experience at a law firm (AmLaw 100 preferred), in-house, or preferably both
  • Ability to deliver polished work product and effectively collaborate with clients and negotiate with third parties
  • Strong drafting skills and the ability to identify, incorporate and improve client-preferred terms
  • Commitment to integrity, excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to lead with empathy
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple matters simultaneously
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and high attention to detail


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health/Sport Budget
  • Fully remote

title: Senior Counsel
description:
Our Senior Counsel will be responsible for leading client correspondence and managing client relationships. We value organized, collegial and highly motivated individuals with a client-centered approach to legal representation. This position is ideal for an entrepreneurial attorney who possesses strong leadership and communication skills and who thrives in a dynamic environment. The Senior Counsel will help shape our legal services, counseling our clients with clear and concise contract drafting, communicating with clients’ internal and external stakeholders, leading complex commercial negotiations, and providing counsel on general risk management. This role is for someone who is committed to offering best-in-class legal services and has a desire to be a proactive strategic partner.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the negotiation of SaaS agreements for clients negotiating with Fortune 500 customers, and identify, coordinate and resolve issues for subject matter expert review
  • Support clients’ business units with structuring and negotiating a variety of transactions relating to product commercialization and corporate development, including early-stage investments, joint ventures, and mergers and acquisitions
  • Provide general counsel and partner with third party subject matter experts to efficiently lead a comprehensive legal strategy
  • Assist with corporate governance processes including managing internal corporate actions, charters, bylaws, and board meeting materials

  • Operate with limited supervision, demonstrate sound judgment and an ability to independently and effectively manage priorities, and proactively identify when to escalate issues with internal and client stakeholders

title: Coordenador/a Financeiro/a (Atuação em Obras)
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade de Coordenador/a Financeiro/a para atuar em uma de nossas obras na região de Salvador/BA. Este/a profissional orientará decisões financeiras estratégicas alinhadas aos objetivos do projeto, assegurando a eficiência dos recursos , tendo estas principais atribuições:


  • Assegurar o correto funcionamento dos controles internos de contas a pagar e tesouraria, visando o cumprimento das diretrizes financeiras corporativas;
  • Elaborar demonstrações financeiras (DRE, BP, FC), modelos financeiros e análises de viabilidade;
  • Contribuir para gestão de caixa integrada do ambiente em que atua, qualificando e otimizando a programação financeira do projetos;
  • Atuar de forma proativa na redução de custos e gestão eficiente do caixa;
  • Dominar os procedimentos e conceitos contábeis, garantindo a correta alocação, os devidos registros de lançamentos, cumprimento das diretrizes financeiras e uso dos manuais de melhores práticas;
  • Apoiar a montagem dos negócios, através do conhecimento das diferentes estruturas societárias (consórcio, SPE, controlada direta e etc.);
  • Dominar os principais impostos incidentes no projeto, buscando a melhor gestão dos fiscal com vistas a manter a Segurança Empresarial;
  • Promover diretrizes orçamentárias, modelos de planejamento, acompanhamento e avaliação de desempenho do projeto, alinhado ao modelo de gestão definido pela Matriz;
  • Garantir assertividade no processo orçamentário, seja pela qualificação das equipes, pelo domínio das ferramentas e sistemas e através do conhecimento das características do ambiente de atuação do projeto, sempre qualificando as informações e propondo novos KPIs para acompanhamento;
  • Representar a companhia junto a terceiros (auditores, sócios, fornecedores, fisco e etc.), dominando os demonstrativos financeiros da operação.


Perfil Requerido:

  • Formação Superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou demais áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-Graduação ou MBA nas áreas de Finanças Corporativas, Controladoria, Administração de Negócios ou correlatos;
  • Experiência profissional comprovada em posições de liderança na área de Finanças;
  • Vivência anterior em empresas do ramo de Construção Civil Pesada ou Montagens Industriais será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos avançados dos principais softwares do Pacote Office;
  • Disponibilidade / mobilidade para atuar em regime 100% presencial na região de Salvador/BA.



Sobre a Odebrecht:


A Odebrecht Engenharia & Construção é uma empresa que presta serviços nos segmentos de construção civil pesada e construção, montagem e manutenção de empreendimentos industriais, sediada no Brasil e atende além deste país, outros quatro mercados: Brasil, Angola e Estados Unidos. Composta por mais de 20 mil Integrantes, a Odebrecht gera oportunidades de trabalho para as populações locais e contribui para o desenvolvimento sustentável de cada região, atuando nas seguintes áreas:


✔ Transporte e Logística

✔ Energia

✔ Saneamento

✔ Engenharia Industrial

✔ Desenvolvimento Urbano e Edificações



Nossa Cultura:


A Nossa Cultura é um conjunto de princípios, conceitos e critérios, com foco na educação e no trabalho, que provê os fundamentos éticos, morais e conceituais para a atuação dos integrantes do Grupo. Valorizamos potencialidades do ser humano, como a disposição para servir, a capacidade e o desejo de evoluir e a vontade de superar resultados. Acreditamos, com convicção e determinação, que a prática da Cultura Odebrecht e das nossas políticas, com atuação ética, íntegra e transparente e o compromisso em promover a diversidade, nos fortalecem e aumentam a nossa competitividade, no rumo da sobrevivência, do crescimento e da perpetuidade.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Full Stack Developer (Java Spring Boot | Ruby on Rails | Angular)

Experience: 7+ years

Work location: Heredia, Costa Rica & remote for LATAM

English Required: B2+ - C1

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Java Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular to lead complex application development initiatives. The ideal candidate will be a strong technical contributor with a proven track record in building scalable, high-performance systems. While excelling in backend implementation and frontend execution. This role is ideal for a technically strong developer who is ready to expand their impact beyond code delivery into collaborative leadership, stakeholder communication, and architectural decision-making.

Require Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Java Spring Boot and core Java (OOP, data structures, algorithms).
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and full-stack web development.
  • Proven experience with Angular and modern frontend technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js).
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud-native development.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Docker, and deployment automation tools.
  • Effective communication across global teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end development of scalable, secure, and maintainable applications using Spring Boot, Ruby on Rails, and Angular .
  • Deliver high-quality code with a strong emphasis on performance, security, and clean architecture .
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, QA teams, and other team members to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Drive technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and standardization across teams.
  • Represent technical solutions and communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executives.
  • Proactively identify risks and implement mitigation strategies in project planning and execution.
  • Contribute to migration projects, system modernization, and platform upgrades with minimal disruption.

title: Atlassian Consultant
description:
Company Description

At Atlas Bench, we are committed to transforming teamwork across industries through innovative Atlassian services. Our global team, proficient in DevOps and ITSM, specializes in agile methodologies and AI solutions tailored for Atlassian products. Serving over 1000 clients, including Fortune 500 companies, we are known for managed licensing, consulting, and AI-driven Atlassian integrations. Our diverse team brings cutting-edge solutions to every project, trusted by leading global firms and reflected in our client success stories.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for an Atlassian Consultant. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing and configuring Atlassian products such as Jira and Confluence, providing training to clients, and ensuring the smooth integration of Atlassian tools into their workflow. You will also consult on best practices, develop custom solutions to meet client needs, and provide ongoing support and maintenance.

Qualifications
  • Experience with configuring and implementing Atlassian products like Jira, Confluence, and JSM
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps practices and ITSM methodologies
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies and AI solutions for Atlassian tools
  • Skills in providing training and support for Atlassian tools
  • Excellent communication and consulting skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Fortune 500 clients or large-scale enterprise projects is a plus

title: Senior Data Product Analyst
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Product Analyst (Remote, US Central Time Zone Hours)

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will collaborate with the data products team to perform a variety of analytics-related tasks, including creating dashboards, building tables, and conducting in-depth data analyses. This position requires strong experience working in an Azure environment and the ability to work remotely while aligning with US Central Time Zone hours.


This role would be ideal for someone with a strong Data Engineering background who wants to be part of the Data Product team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
  • Perform data analysis and data profiling, identifying new data sources to enhance business processes.
  • Develop, refine, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support decision-making.
  • Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including creating test plans based on stakeholder discussions and adapting existing tests for new use cases.
  • Document processes, findings, and methodologies to ensure transparency and reusability.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders.
  • Proven experience in data analysis, data profiling, and delivering analytics solutions.
  • Expertise in SQL.
  • Experience working in an Azure environment.
  • Familiarity with UAT processes, including test creation and execution.
  • Attention to detail and ability to document workflows and findings.



If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for transforming data into actionable insights, we’d love to hear from you.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will collaborate with the data products team to perform a variety of analytics-related tasks, including creating dashboards, building tables, and conducting in-depth data analyses. This position requires strong experience working in an Azure environment and the ability to work remotely while aligning with US Central Time Zone hours.


This role would be ideal for someone with a strong Data Engineering background who wants to be part of the Data Product team.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
  • Perform data analysis and data profiling, identifying new data sources to enhance business processes.
  • Develop, refine, and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics products to support decision-making.
  • Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including creating test plans based on stakeholder discussions and adapting existing tests for new use cases.
  • Document processes, findings, and methodologies to ensure transparency and reusability.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with stakeholders.
  • Proven experience in data analysis, data profiling, and delivering analytics solutions.
  • Expertise in SQL.
  • Experience working in an Azure environment.
  • Familiarity with UAT processes, including test creation and execution.
  • Attention to detail and ability to document workflows and findings.



If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for transforming data into actionable insights, we’d love to hear from you.

title: AI Legal Ops Intern
description:
AI Legal Ops Internship at Jumpstart

Location: Remote – Brazil

Compensation: BRL 3,000/month (with growth potential and future equity opportunities)

Hours: 30 per week


About us

We are not just another legal tech startup. We are building the infrastructure to transform the 10-billion-dollar U.S. immigration market, a system that is currently broken, slow and unfair.

Our product utilizes AI to automate legal workflows, predict case outcomes and provide immigrants with something no one else offers: certainty. If their petition is not approved, they get their money back.

We are at the beginning of something massive. We are looking for individuals who want to be part of the journey from 0 to 1, help build a billion-dollar company and own a stake in it.


What We’re Looking For

We do not care if you have worked at a big firm or have a fancy title.

We care if you are:

  • Desperate to learn, willing to move fast, break things and build better.
  • Curious and ambitious, obsessed with the intersection of law, technology and impact.
  • Hungry, driven to help build something huge and take a slice of the upside.
  • Hands-on, ready to work side by side with founders, not sit on the sidelines.


What You’ll Do
  • Collaborate with our legal and AI teams to craft compelling legal petitions and recommendation letters.
  • Structure and organize legal evidence so our AI can produce flawless, high-impact documents.
  • Review and refine AI outputs to ensure legal precision and storytelling excellence.
  • Be part of the core team that is rewriting how immigration is done.


What You Need
  • Law, Computer Science or related degree in progress.
  • Excellent research and writing skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Strong appetite for learning fast, solving problems and building from scratch.
  • Zero ego, high energy.


Why Join Us
  • Be part of a hyper-early-stage company with massive upside.
  • Work directly with founders on a mission to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry.
  • Real ownership and growth, not just busywork.
  • Learn more in six months than most people learn in three years.


This is not a regular internship. If you are hungry, ambitious and want to help build something from the ground up, this is your shot.

title: Desenvolvedor com foco em automações de processos e IA
description:
O Grupo NTSec é o resultado da união da ZivaSec , NTSec , InfoSec e CloudSec , empresas do mercado de tecnologia. Somos uma plataforma de soluções inovadoras em segurança, com talentos excepcionais e o compromisso de conectar o futuro dos nossos clientes à proteção que eles precisam.

Com mais de 300 profissionais que chamamos de Secpowers ⚡ espalhados em todo o Brasil e temos escritórios em Brasília (DF), Cuiabá (MT), Curitiba (PR), Fortaleza (CE), Goiânia (GO), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP) , estamos em constante expansão.


Reconhecidos 3 vezes pelo Great Place to Work™ , temos uma cultura forte, baseada em inovação, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade e respeito .


Se você se identifica com esse ambiente, essa vaga pode ser sua!


Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor de novas soluções e integrações com Inteligência Artificial para fazer parte do nosso time de tecnologia. Este profissional será responsável por criar, integrar, manter e automatizar soluções utilizando técnicas de programação e aplicação de inteligência artificial, apoiando os projetos de inovação e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Dentro do time suas principais responsabilidades serão:


  • Desenvolver integrações entre sistemas utilizando ferramentas de automação e programação.
  • Criar e manter fluxos de automação.
  • Aplicar conceitos de inteligência artificial para otimizar e automatizar processos.

title: Senior Software Engineer (L5)
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • 3+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Administrador de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Customização e evolução da ferramenta de glossário de termos, alinhando a conceitos de domínios e capacidades do framework BIAN,

Desenvolver e aplicar regras na ferramenta de pré validação de modelos de dados utilizando Regex em C#,

Apoiar o time de Governança de Dados na adoção dos padrões BIAN,

Administrar e modelar dados (conceitual, lógica e física),

Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados,

Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, analistas e equipes de desenvolvimento.


Habilidades e Requisitos


Experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados,

Conhecimento prático em automação processos e ferramentas de IA

Conhecimento na esteira CI/CD,

Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem como Erwin ou similares,

Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL,

Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas,

Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (LAMP)
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience and strong problem-solving abilities, quickly learn new technologies and concepts, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent. The client provides industry-leading software for environmental compliance, fuel management, and facility maintenance in the retail and commercial fuel industry. Their platform helps major fuel networks, including global brands, monitor and optimize their operations by delivering real-time insights, automating compliance tasks, and ensuring site uptime.

As a software engineer on this team, you'll have the opportunity to work on scalable cloud-based solutions that make a measurable impact on sustainability and operational efficiency in a mission-critical industry. More specifically, you will work to modernize an application that enables quick deployments into international cloud regions to support markets with data residency restrictions, provide updates, and strengthen its security posture.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance an existing LAMP-based web application to ensure continued stability and performance
  • Design and develop modern application components, including both front-end features and back-end services
  • Take technical ownership of features, contributing to both functional and technical specifications to align with business goals
  • Independently deliver high-quality product features and updates, while proactively seeking guidance when needed to maintain momentum
  • Write and execute unit tests to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Investigate and resolve defects identified during QA and user acceptance testing cycles
  • Actively participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to discuss priorities, progress, and share ideas or technical insights
  • Apply a solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to projects of increasing complexity, with a focus on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • System analysis and design
  • Effort estimation
  • Sprint and release planning

Required Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience using PHP, Linux (AWS EC2), Apache, and MySQL to build and maintain production-grade, commercial web applications
  • Hands-on experience with AWS CloudFormation (infrastructure as code) and deploying containerized applications using AWS ECS (Docker)
  • Solid understanding of Agile development practices, object-oriented programming, and multi-tiered software architectures
  • Proven ability to work independently while recognizing when to collaborate or seek guidance to meet deadlines and maintain high quality
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and practical communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts
  • Adaptable and open to change, with a proactive attitude and passion for continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, creative, and accountable in delivering work to a high standard


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiarity with AWS networking concepts, including VPC design and VPN configuration.
  • Experience working with AWS SQS for decoupled, event-driven architectures and AWS S3 for object storage and data lifecycle management.


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Senior Systems Administrator (Tableau servers)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Tableau Server Administrator to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. The end client is in the retail/food services/technology area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


Only resumes in English will be reviewed. All interviews will be in English only (must be fluent)


Responsibilities:

  • Ability to setup and configure Tableau servers on various on prem and cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with server upgrades and parameter changes
  • Proficiency in connecting Tableau to different data sources and extract data from these sources
  • Manage user permissions, security, and access within Tableau environments
  • Troubleshoot Tableau performance issues and optimizing dashboards


Requirements:

  • Minimum 10 years of IT experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Tableau Servers
  • Strong understanding of Tableau architecture, including workbooks, data sources, extract refresh schedules, and server maintenance.
  • Knowledge of Tableau Server features, including scheduling, content management, and server configuration.
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL) to troubleshoot data-related issues.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or batch scripting for automating administrative tasks is a plus.
  • Understanding of data governance concepts and experience implementing data security measures in Tableau.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS) is a plus but not required
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to explain and understand problems effectively
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills
  • Time zone: Pacific Time Zone preferred, but flexibility is possible

title: Technical Project Manager  – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks
description:
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks with strong expertise in mobile and converged network architectures to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Nokia network solutions, virtualization technologies, and key signaling protocols, and will play a crucial role in aligning network strategies with customer and business objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support mobile networks (2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G) and fixed/converged network architectures.
  • Manage and optimize virtualized environments using Nokia CBIS VMs , containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms such as NCS.
  • Work with Nokia network elements and third-party systems including CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, and CSD .
  • Troubleshoot and optimize signaling protocols such as SIP, Diameter, and S7 .
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver network solutions aligned with customer and Nokia objectives.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and project risks effectively.
  • Provide deep analytical support and troubleshoot complex network issues.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of mobile network technologies (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), fixed and converged networks.
  • Experience with virtualization and container platforms (Nokia CBIS , Docker , Kubernetes , NCS ).
  • Familiarity with Nokia network components (CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, CSD ) and third-party solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, Diameter, and S7 protocols.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with customers and internal stakeholders to meet technical and business goals.
  • Excellent risk management, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting aptitude.
  • Proficiency in English.

P

referred Qualifications

  • Certifications or relevant education in Telecommunications, Networking, or related fields.
  • Prior experience working with Nokia systems and large-scale network deployments.

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 60+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Roles we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Business Analyst
  • Data Analyst
  • Data Scientist
  • Designer
  • Finance Analyst

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Mobile - Especialista (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Apparel Designer
description:
Job Title: Apparel Designer

Permanent Remote | Part-time


Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re partnered with a growing infant clothing and accessories brand that’s looking for an experienced and highly creative Apparel Designer to join their team remotely! This role is ideal for someone who can take a founder’s or creative director’s vision and translate it into production-ready designs that are safe, comfortable, and true to the brand’s aesthetic. If you thrive in both concept development and technical garment execution, this is the opportunity for you.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Collaborate closely with the brand’s founder and creative team to interpret design concepts and ideas into cohesive, marketable infantwear collections
  • Develop sketches, mood boards, and detailed tech packs ready for manufacturing
  • Select fabrics, trims, and color palettes that bring each collection to life while ensuring comfort, softness, and safety for babies
  • Oversee design revisions to ensure feasibility for production without compromising aesthetic quality
  • Research and apply emerging trends, silhouettes, and materials relevant to infant apparel and accessories
  • Communicate with pattern makers and production partners to confirm design accuracy and ensure seamless execution
  • Maintain organized digital design files and version control throughout the design cycle


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Bilingual Spanish candidates preferred!)
  • More than 5 years of experience in apparel design, with previous work in infantwear or children’s clothing a strong plus
  • A portfolio that shows your range: sketches, flats, mood boards, and final garments (infantwear samples preferred)
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern making (basic knowledge is a plus), and fabrics appropriate for infant clothing
  • Available to work US business hours (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D



Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - USD 1,000 per month , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a part-time role requiring a 20-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


Additional Benefits

If the role transitions to full-time, you’ll gain access to additional benefits such as paid time off, health insurance, and eligibility to our Elite VA Program—plus ongoing career support from the StaffRight team.

  • Collaborate closely with the brand’s founder and creative team to interpret design concepts and ideas into cohesive, marketable infantwear collections
  • Develop sketches, mood boards, and detailed tech packs ready for manufacturing

  • Oversee design revisions to ensure feasibility for production without compromising aesthetic quality
  • Research and apply emerging trends, silhouettes, and materials relevant to infant apparel and accessories
  • Communicate with pattern makers and production partners to confirm design accuracy and ensure seamless execution
  • Maintain organized digital design files and version control throughout the design cycle


What We’re Looking For:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (Bilingual Spanish candidates preferred!)
  • More than 5 years of experience in apparel design, with previous work in infantwear or children’s clothing a strong plus
  • A portfolio that shows your range: sketches, flats, mood boards, and final garments (infantwear samples preferred)
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D
  • Strong understanding of garment construction, pattern making (basic knowledge is a plus), and fabrics appropriate for infant clothing
  • Available to work US business hours (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace
  • Proficiency in digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or CLO3D



Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary starting at USD 800 - USD 1,000 per month , with flexibility for higher compensation based on your experience and qualifications. This is a part-time role requiring a 20-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


Additional Benefits

If the role transitions to full-time, you’ll gain access to additional benefits such as paid time off, health insurance, and eligibility to our Elite VA Program—plus ongoing career support from the StaffRight team.
